audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Blinding Dart as if it shuts off Warwick's whole kit ('so your Q-empowered hits whiff'), and never says what it does and does not touch.
audit.why: Blind stops basic attacks — which also stops Eternal Hunger's heal, since that rides the attack. Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress are casts and land in full, healing included. Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank, so the window is countable.
audit.corrected: Blind scoped to autos and the passive heal; Q named as still landing and still healing; the flat 7s written into the Do's and the level 3-5 spike.
sources: Teemo kit Q text and cd 7

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl appeared nowhere, and Teemo's move speed was credited to his passive.
audit.why: Primal Howl's 2.5s of damage reduction is what turns his poke exchange around, on 15s at rank 1 against a flat 7s dart. His passive is the invisibility/Element of Surprise; Move Quick (W) is the speed.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl written into the mid text with its numbers; Move Quick named as the speed tool.
sources: Teemo kit P and W text

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], whys[2] and whys[4] say 'favours you' while win[0], win[2] and win[4] said Teemo or Skill, and Teemo held 6 of 7 stages.
audit.why: The packet chart matches the prose: Warwick owns level 1, level 3 and level 6 (where his R is a cast the blind cannot touch); Teemo owns 4-5 and both item stages once shrooms and DoT items arrive. Warwick's 47.77% is consistent with losing the scaling half rather than every stage.
audit.corrected: Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Teemo, Warwick, Teemo, Teemo — paired across both layers with ratings raised on the Warwick rows.

audit.why: Spike stages are right — Blood Hunt at 3, level 6, his first DoT item, and late shroom control — and the level-6 spike already states the cast-versus-blind point correctly.

edits.before: W Blood Hunt speed closes the gap before Teemo can kite, and Q Jaws sustain heals his auto poison poke — all-in whenever his Q Blinding Dart is on cooldown, since blind neuters your autos.
edits.after: Blood Hunt speed closes the gap before Teemo can kite, and Jaws of the Beast still lands and still heals while blinded — it is a cast. Commit in the 7s after Blinding Dart.

edits.before: Level 3 is yours with Blood Hunt speed to catch him, but Level 4 flips to Teemo as his poke and blind uptime grow. Level 5 swings back to you, and at 6 your un-blindable R lets you pin him through Blinding Dart for a kill.
edits.after: Level 3 is yours with Blood Hunt speed to catch him, but 4-5 flip to Teemo as blind uptime grows. Hold Primal Howl (15s) for his step-up — 2.5s of damage reduction eats the poke — and at 6 your R is a cast, so blind cannot stop it.

edits.before: Blind your autos with Q so your Q-empowered hits whiff
edits.after: Blind your autos with Q — your Eternal Hunger heal stops

edits.before: Kite with move-speed passive and poison DoT chip
edits.after: Kite with Move Quick (W) and poison DoT chip

edits.before: Blinds your on-hit autos. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds your autos and your passive heal, not your Q or R. Flat 7s — count it.

notes: The load-bearing fix is scope: Blinding Dart stops basic attacks (and with them Eternal Hunger's heal) but not Jaws of the Beast or Infinite Duress, which are casts — the page previously implied the blind beat the whole kit. Teemo's move speed also belonged to Move Quick (W), not his passive, which is the invisibility. Cleanse/QSS behaviour against the suppression is not in the kit file and is not asserted anywhere. Chart set to the packet chart, which the existing why-lines already described.
